item_short_desc: Enhance your card game experience with our Poker Playing Cards, featuring 52 cards and 2 jokers. Each card showcases three views and the name of either a friendly or enemy aircraft, along with standard playing card indexes, allowing you to enjoy both educational and traditional card games.
